strategy_ideas: Test a VWAP‑bounce strategy that includes the rvol > 1.2 filter and a trailing stop to capture upside once the price confirms above VWAP.
Implement an opening‑range breakout rule that requires price above VWAP and rvol > 1.2, and use a tighter stop (0.2% below VWAP) to protect against false breakouts.
